+async function fcRefreshOwnEntryForChallengeV1288(ch) {
+  const uid = state.profile?.id;
+  if (!uid || !ch?.id) return null;
+  try {
+    const { data, error } = await db.from('entries')
+      .select('id, challenge_id, user_id, media_url, poster_url, media_type, caption, moderation_status, moderation_reason, moderation_checked_at, created_at, sd_round')
+      .eq('challenge_id', ch.id)
+      .eq('user_id', uid)
+      .order('created_at', { ascending:false })
+      .limit(20);
+    if (error) throw error;
+    const rows = data || [];
+    const currentRound = ch.sd_phase === 'submitting' ? Number(ch.sd_round || 0) : 0;
+    const row = rows.find(e => Number(e.sd_round || 0) === currentRound) || rows[0] || null;
+    if (row) {
+      const merge = arr => [row, ...(arr || []).filter(e => String(e?.id || '') !== String(row.id))];
+      state.feedEntries = merge(state.feedEntries);
+      if (String(state.currentChallenge?.id || '') === String(ch.id)) state.currentEntries = merge(state.currentEntries);
+    }
+    return row;
+  } catch (e) {
+    console.warn('Own entry refresh', e);
+    return null;
+  }
+}
+function fcSyncEntryModerationBannerV1288(ch, entry) {
+  const form = document.getElementById('submitEntryForm');
+  if (!form) return;
+  let banner = document.getElementById('seModerationStateV1288');
+  if (!banner) {
+    banner = document.createElement('div');
+    banner.id = 'seModerationStateV1288';
+    banner.className = 'fc-entry-moderation-state-v1288';
+    form.insertBefore(banner, form.firstChild);
+  }
+  const ux = fcEntryModerationUxV1288(entry);
+  if (!ux) {
+    banner.hidden = true;
+    banner.className = 'fc-entry-moderation-state-v1288';
+    banner.innerHTML = '';
+    return;
+  }
+  banner.hidden = false;
+  banner.className = `fc-entry-moderation-state-v1288 ${ux.kind}`;
+  const detail = ux.kind === 'rejected'
+    ? `${ux.detail} Your existing upload will stay rejected until you choose a new file.`
+    : `${ux.detail} You can replace it before entries close if you want to submit a different video.`;
+  banner.innerHTML = `<div class="fc-entry-moderation-badge-v1288">${escapeHtml(ux.label)}</div><strong>${escapeHtml(ux.title)}</strong><p>${escapeHtml(detail)}</p>`;
